parsed.rationale: Customer requests scheduling weekly exports directly to an S3 bucket instead of manually downloading CSVs; they state it is not blocking and would save time weekly.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there—thanks for the suggestion. Scheduling weekly exports directly to your S3 bucket (instead of downloading CSVs manually) sounds like a great workflow improvement.

We can pass this along to our product/engineering team as a feature request. To help us route it correctly, could you share what export format(s) you’d need (CSV only or also other formats) and whether you want a single bucket/path per export or configurable destinations for different data sets?

It’s not blocking you today—we’ll still make sure your use case is captured for future planning.
promised_actions: Share the request with product/engineering as a feature request
Request details needed to route the feature request
safety_notes: No promise of delivery timeline or availability.
No assumptions made about current product capabilities beyond what was described.

parsed.customer_impact: Would save the customer’s data team time each week by eliminating manual CSV downloads and replacing them with scheduled exports to their S3 bucket.
grounded_facts: The requester is asking to schedule weekly exports directly to an S3 bucket.
The requester currently downloads CSVs manually.
They state the request is not blocking for them.
They estimate it would save their data team a couple of hours each week.
parsed.summary: The requester wants the ability to schedule weekly exports directly to their S3 bucket instead of manually downloading CSVs.
